title: Rav Huna bar Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 143a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.143a.9), where Rav Ashi said to Rav Mordekhai: “This is why I saw Rav Huna bar Avya in a dream.” Hyman suggests that possibly he is the one mentioned in [Chullin 47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.47a.5), Rav Huna Mar bar Avya, who said to Rav Ashi, “All these wild animals have it this way”; and there at [49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.3), Huna Mar son of Rav Idi — Dikdukei Soferim reads bar Avya — who disagrees with Rav Ada bar Minyomi; they came and asked Ravina.[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=994&lang=en) also puts the dream and the lung-lobe episode under Huna Mar bar Avya. The consulted Chullin 49a calls the third figure Huna Mar son of Rav Idi. Hyman reports bar Avya as a Dikdukei Soferim variant.
